C0625.title: Chongqing Police Crack Credit Card Cash-Out Case Involving Over Ten Repayment Apps
C0625.summary: In May 2023, Chongqing police disclosed a major suspected illegal business operation case. The criminal group developed and operated more than ten credit-card repayment apps, including "Shandian Life". Customers created orders in the apps and used fake commodity transactions to cash out credit-card funds before returning the money to designated credit cards or debit cards. Police carried out coordinated arrests in Chongqing, Guizhou and Jiangsu, detained 20 suspects, and found more than 110,000 cash-out and repayment customers with 6 billion yuan involved.
